name: L1e-B Two-Wheel Moped, up to 4 kW and 45 km/h
description: The two-wheel moped of Regulation (EU) No 168/2013 the classifications naming this group share, speed pedelecs included: a light two-wheeler of no more than 4,000 W and 45 km/h that isn't an L1e-A powered cycle. A vehicle carries this group's id in place of each classification in it, and each of those holds its own jurisdiction's licence, registration, insurance, helmet and riding rules.

restrictions.rule: Two wheels and a maximum design speed of 45 km/h or less
Maximum continuous rated or net power of 4,000 W or less
No more than 4,000 mm long, 1,000 mm wide and 2,500 mm tall, and any petrol engine is 50 cm³ or less
Any such vehicle that isn't an L1e-A powered cycle, so a pedal cycle assisting past 25 km/h or with more than 1,000 W is one
A two-wheeler past these limits is an L3e motorcycle instead
